_book_key_errors.why: The stem gives a road 15 m wide, a first building 12 m high, and an angle of ELEVATION of 30 degrees, so the second building rises 15*tan(30) = 15/sqrt(3) = 5*sqrt(3) above the first. The key's 15*sqrt(3) is 15*tan(60). It is self-refuting against its own stem: a rise of 15*sqrt(3) over a horizontal run of 15 m gives tan = sqrt(3), i.e. 60 degrees, not the 30 degrees the question states. The cause is visible in the book itself — Practice set 6.2 Q.3 is the same question shape at 60 degrees (road 12 m, first building 10 m) and is correctly keyed (10 + 12*sqrt(3)); the 'h1 + width*sqrt(3)' pattern was carried across to a 30-degree question where it does not hold. Verified at 3x zoom on the printed key page: the coefficient is unambiguously 15.
